items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Keep private and preview-only. Official Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms point against those uses. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains conditional when it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries and adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Fleet compliance is a technical baseline, not legal certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown; open findings include banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, and terms checks. Do not treat incomplete telemetry alone as a growth blocker, but do not clear public launch or rights-dependent monetization where compliance, privacy, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, or age-sensitive evidence is missing. Continue only bounded reversible work within existing boundaries.

Revenue and data-quality disposition: analytics coverage is healthy for configured sites; scaffold properties remain unconfigured and must not be treated as zero. Amazon evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate results of 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, which cannot be assigned to a site. Preserve revenue, ROI, margin, cost, and causal-lift fields as unknown; authorize no monetization expansion or spend.
